newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends off in erratic trade.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends off in erratic trade.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar softened in erratic trade to close at 473.75/475.00 per dollar as traders were left confused by an apparent shift in the Central Bank's approach to the foreign exchange market, traders said.
"It seems as though the Bank doesn't mind more volatility in the market, but within certain levels," said one trader.
"The Bank clearly separated today what was intervention from what was supplying the market with liquidity," said another broker.

As state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela must remit by law all of its petro-dollars to the Central Bank, the Bank is the market's largest single supplier of dollars. This blurs the distinction between intervention and supplying liquidity, trader say.
"Today it only intervened with little droplets," added the broker.
The unit closed Friday at 473.25/474.25 bolivars per dollar.
